verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion capsule has splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego... April 10, 2026.' 'perfect bullseye splashdown'; R2: 'splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'; R3: 'splashed down as planned in the Pacific Ocean off San Diego'; R4: 'splash down off San Diego's coast'; R5: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego... April 10, 2026'
